Since you appear to be in New York, look for **licensed dispensary products** with the NYS universal cannabis symbol and lab-tested THC labeling. New York allows up to **10 mg THC per serving** for adult-use edibles. [cannabis.ny.gov](https://cannabis.ny.gov/system/files/documents/2023/04/aucp-terms-and-conditions-and-guidance_0.pdf?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

If you're new to edibles, NY's OCM recommends starting around **2.5 mg THC** and waiting **up to 2 hours** before taking more. [cannabis.ny.gov](https://cannabis.ny.gov/know-your-edibles?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
